comment: C ref: save.c dosave0():111-124 in explore mode. Segment 1 saves. Segment 2 restores, keeps the save file at unixmain.c's "Do you want to keep the save file?", and saves again; dosave0() finds the old file and the answer y to "Overwrite the old file?" goes on to save. Segment 3 restores the new file, declines to keep it, and pages back through the message history. Seed, clock and character chosen independently.
